title: Computational Design of RNA Aptamers Targeting Oncogenic miR-10b Using T‑SELEX and Molecular Dynamics-Based Stability Metrics.
authors: Mokgopa, Kabelo Phuti; Lobb, Kevin A; Tshiwawa, Tendamudzimu
one_liner_zh: 该文用T-SELEX框架结合MD模拟和MM-GBSA计算设计靶向miR-10b的RNA适配体，虽对象为RNA而非蛋白质，但其结构预测、对接和MD稳定性评估的计算流程可迁移至蛋白质结构计算，故给予中档评分。
abstract: Aptamers are versatile single-stranded nucleic acids with high specificity and stability, making them ideal for targeting challenging biomolecules. Their structural flexibility enables selective recognition of nonprotein targets such as microRNAs (miRNAs). Among these, miR-10b plays a pivotal role in cancer progression and metastasis through its oncogenic 5p and 3p arms. We propose designing aptamers specifically targeting miR-10b through a computational framework to enable precise and efficient regulation of aberrant miRNA activity in cancer. Herein, we introduce a multiscale computational workflow built on the T_SELEX framework, integrating sequence generation, folding of secondary and tertiary structure prediction, then virtual screening, quantum mechanical (QM) calculations, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, and MM-GBSA analysis for the design and evaluation of RNA aptamer candidates targeting pre-miR-10b and its mature 5p and 3p arms. This robust workflow enables large-scale identification and structural evaluation of computationally promising RNA aptamer candidates for RNA-targeted drug discovery. In this study, a library of 1100 22-mer aptamers was virtually screened, with heatmap and interaction energy analyses revealing strong affinities toward hsa-miR-25-5p. Molecular docking identified aptamer557 as the top binder to miR-10b-3p with -545.96 docking score and aptamer899 as the best for miR-10b-5p with -482.55 docking score. QM single-point calculations assessed electronic stability via total molecular energy and the HOMO-LUMO gaps, showing model-dependent variations. MD simulations incorporated novel stability metrics combining RMSD area integration and changepoint detection, alongside hydrogen bonding, RMSF, and radius of gyration analyses. The miR-10b-3p complexes exhibited lower RMSF and RMSD values with more persistent hydrogen bonds, reflecting stronger and more stable interactions than 5p complexes. Interestingly, despite both the aptamer and target miRNA adopting folded secondary and tertiary structures, partial Watson-Crick interactions were observed during both docking and molecular dynamics simulations, particularly at accessible loop and terminal regions, suggesting a hybrid binding mechanism involving localized base pairing together with structure-dependent structural recognition. MM-GBSA binding energy analysis further supported these findings, confirming that our T-SELEX-guided in silico strategy identifies computationally promising aptamer-like candidates and provides a robust framework for the rational design of RNA-targeting therapeutics.
abstract_zh: 适配体（aptamer）是一类多功能的单链核酸，具有高特异性和稳定性，使其成为靶向具有挑战性的生物分子的理想工具。其结构灵活性使其能够选择性识别非蛋白质靶标，如微小RNA（microRNA, miRNA）。其中，miR-10b通过其致癌性5p和3p臂在癌症进展和转移中发挥关键作用。我们提出通过计算框架设计特异性靶向miR-10b的适配体，以实现对癌症中异常miRNA活性的精确高效调控。在此，我们介绍一种基于T_SELEX框架构建的多尺度计算工作流程，整合序列生成、二级和三级结构预测的折叠、虚拟筛选、量子力学（quantum mechanical, QM）计算、分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟以及MM-GBSA分析，用于设计和评估靶向pre-miR-10b及其成熟5p和3p臂的RNA适配体候选物。这一稳健的工作流程能够实现大规模识别和结构评估计算上具有前景的RNA适配体候选物，从而推动RNA靶向药物发现。在本研究中，对1100个22-mer适配体文库进行了虚拟筛选，热图和相互作用能分析显示其与hsa-miR-25-5p具有强亲和力。分子对接鉴定出适配体557为miR-10b-3p的最佳结合物，对接得分为-545.96，适配体899为miR-10b-5p的最佳结合物，对接得分为-482.55。QM单点计算通过总分子能和HOMO-LUMO能隙评估电子稳定性，显示出模型依赖性差异。MD模拟引入了结合RMSD面积积分和变点检测的新型稳定性指标，同时进行了氢键、RMSF和回旋半径分析。miR-10b-3p复合物表现出较低的RMSF和RMSD值，并具有更持久的氢键，反映出比5p复合物更强、更稳定的相互作用。有趣的是，尽管适配体和靶标miRNA均采用折叠的二级和三级结构，但在对接和分子动力学模拟过程中均观察到部分Watson-Crick相互作用，特别是在可及的环区和末端区域，这表明存在一种涉及局部碱基配对和结构依赖性识别的混合结合机制。MM-GBSA结合能分析进一步支持了这些发现，证实我们基于T-SELEX引导的计算机模拟策略能够识别计算上具有前景的适配体样候选物，并为RNA靶向治疗药物的合理设计提供了稳健框架。
